entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF789-0123.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 20 days ago, on the 10th of last month. Is that correct?
Yeah, that sounds about right. So, how do I start the return?
I see. I do apologize, but it looks like this item is outside of its return window. The VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy due to the nature of the device.
What? No, your website says 90 days for returns. Ten days is completely unacceptable!

I understand the confusion, sir. Our standard 90-day policy applies to most of our apparel, like jerseys and shoes, but specific electronics like the Pulse have a stricter 10-day window, which is listed on the product page.
I don't care what the product page says now. This is ridiculous. I want to return it. Let me speak to your boss or a supervisor.
I understand your frustration, and I am empowered to resolve most issues without an escalation. My supervisor will have to tell you the same policy regarding the 10-day window.
I don't believe that. This is terrible service. Get me a manager right now. I'm not hanging up until this is fixed.
I want to find a solution for you. Perhaps you can tell me what prevented you from initiating the return within the first 10 days? Sometimes understanding the circumstances can help.

I TRIED to! I tried to return it on day eight, but your website's return portal was down. It kept giving me a 404 error. I have screenshots! Then I had a family medical emergency and I'm only just now getting back to this.

Oh, I am very sorry to hear about your family emergency, and I sincerely apologize for the technical error you experienced with our website. That is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Thank you for bringing that to my attention.
So you'll process the return then?

While the system physically won't let me process a return for the Pulse after this long, what I can do, given the website error you encountered, is offer you a goodwill credit. As an apology for the trouble, I can add a $50 VeloFit credit directly to your account. You can use it on any future purchase.
Fifty dollars? You're sure you can't just take the return?

I am sure, unfortunately. The policy on that specific item is very strict. But the $50 credit is the maximum I'm authorized to offer as a courtesy, and it's available for you immediately. I hope you'll see it as our way of making things right for the website trouble.
…Okay. Fine. A $50 credit is better than nothing, I guess. It's not my fault your site was broken.

I completely agree, and I've made a note on our internal log about the portal error you mentioned. I have just applied that $50 credit to your account. You should see it reflected online within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you for your help, Alex. I appreciate you finding a solution.
You're very welcome. Thank you for your patience and for being a VeloFit customer. Have a great day.
